मुञ्ज king of Dhārā, uncle and predecessor of Bhoja
of Dhārā, called also Vākpatirājadeva, reigned in 993.
Mentioned in Sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇa

^a, by
Śambhu in Rājendrakarṇapūra v. 17, by Arjunavarma-
deva on Amaruśataka 22. The Jain Amitagati wrote
his insipid Subhāṣitaratnasaṃdoha during his reign.

मुञ्ज father of Dāsaśarman (Śāṅkhāyanaśrautasūtrabhāṣya).
W. p. 27.

मुञ्ज of Nandapura, father of Lakṣmīdhara, father of
Sūryadatta, father of Hala (Sarvānukramaṇīpaddhati)
and Āstara. Āstara's descendants were Ananta: Vi-
dyādhara: Śrīkaṇṭha: Lakṣmīdhara: Rāmakṛṣṇa:
Rāmabhadra. W. p. 41.

Bālabodha jy.
 Sārasaṃgraha jy.
 Sāroddhāra jy.

मुञ्जादित्य astronomer:
 Śukrodayāstavicāra.
 Sārasaṃgraha. See Bālabodhasārasaṃgraha.
